title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Health and Nutrition programme will work in Northern Bahr el Ghazal, South Sudan. It aims to contribute to Concern South Sudan’s Health, Nutrition and WASH thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to improve child and maternal health and nutritional status by increasing access to essential integrated health, nutrition services and promoting sustainable behaviour change. The programme will support over 634,484 people living in extreme and poor households with a particular focus on pregnant and lactating mothers, and children under five, female-headed households, pregnant and lactating mothers, households with disabled members. This will be done through increased availability and access to basic quality health/nutrition services and integration opportunities analysed jointly with the Ministry of Health/County Health Department and promoted, improved capacity of the health facility staff to provide comprehensive quality health and nutrition services, increased access to nutritive sensitive agriculture (vegetable production) and participation in VSLAs by vulnerable groups and increased engagement of women and men to promote positive gender roles at community and household level.OBJECTIVES: Improved coverage of quality health & nutrition services among those living in extreme povertyOUTCOMES: Improved child and maternal health and nutritional status by increasing access to essential integrated health, nutrition services and promoting sustainable behaviour change.
